scope: Real typed Rust handler HTTP smoke checks; not browser identity, resource, or packed release qualification.

results.name: direct typed document with admission metadata and native form
negotiated typed destination keeps policy and asset identity
policy/context mismatch is explicit in the representation
same handler supports enhanced and no-JS validation
CSRF and Origin refusal precede mutation
confirmed action mutates once and returns explicit success
enhanced redirect is a typed 303 decision; native form uses HTTP303
all readable actions match bound app/build/group/layout/context/policy/endpoint and actual HTTP status
unreadable POST remains unknown to client; fixture state independently confirms one mutation, without retry
